scope: Worklist of currently known names from OSM suburb/neighbourhood/quarter points, municipal reference lists and collected polygons. Name coverage measures this finite worklist only. It is not a count of every Hungarian neighbourhood, and neither point-only names nor urban planning groups establish official neighbourhood boundaries. Names, aliases, historical schemes and overlapping areas are retained under the user-authorized broad search-area policy. No point was converted into a circle by this script.
